categories.name: Non-Critical Admission
categories.description: Admission of the patient to a non-critical inpatient ward (Admission NC), realizing the goal of admitting an inpatient for ongoing management and eventual discharge.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative id=15 (Admission NC). The narrative sample shows patients routed to Admission NC in standard pathways (e.g. V0008, V0070), supporting the non-critical admission track. It does not warrant further subdivision as the logged activity cleanly realizes the non-critical care alternative.

categories.name: Intensive Care Admission
categories.description: Admission of the patient to an intensive care inpatient unit (Admission IC), realizing the goal of inpatient admission with higher-acuity care. This alternative has a negative contribution (-25) to minimizing time-to-treatment softgoals due to resource constraints or stabilization overhead.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative id=16 (Admission IC). The narrative sample shows this alternative taken in complex or severe cases (e.g., V0605, V0317), reflecting intensive ward routing rather than standard non-critical admission.
